meta.description: LockVFX — visual effects for film, series and advertising: compositing, CGI, environments, cleanup and finishing. The name under which [Name] and [Name] work together.

reel.h1: LockVFX — visual effects for film, series and advertising

statement.phrase: We give shape to the images a film imagines and cannot shoot.
statement.paragraph: LockVFX is the name under which [Name] and [Name] work together: compositing, CGI, environments, cleanup, simulation and finishing for film, series and advertising — with a network of studios and specialists that changes with each project.

errors.name: What should we call you?
errors.email: We need an email to reply to.
errors.message: Two lines are enough: project, timing, what you need.

consent.after: and understand my data will be used only to reply to me.

status.sent: Got it. We’ll get back to you within two working days.
status.failed: It didn’t go through. Try again, or write to us directly:

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.short: We use what you send us (name, email, message) only to reply. No newsletter, no sharing with third parties. We keep it for 24 months after our last exchange, then delete it. Your message is delivered to our inboxes through EmailJS. You can ask us to access or delete your data at any time at {{email}}. Full details in the privacy notice.
privacy.body: The full privacy notice is being prepared and will be published here before the site goes live.

legal.collective: LockVFX is the collective name under which {{a}} and {{b}} present their work. It is not a company: each of them works with their own VAT number and in their own name.
